task: Deliver public GET /api/articles/:slug/comments as its own API PR stacked on PR #61.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/articles/:slug/comments is public and supports an optional valid token; missing articles return 404, invalid optional tokens return 401, and success returns { comments }.

Comments are ordered by createdAt ASC then id ASC; author following is false anonymously and reflects the authenticated viewer using one batched follow lookup; serialization exposes only public fields.

Article existence and comment rows are read in one REPEATABLE READ transaction so concurrent article deletion cannot produce a mixed-snapshot response; persistence failures return the generic documented 500 response.
Generated Swagger and static OpenAPI describe optional authentication, success, 401, 404, and 500 contracts; the PR adds only the GET comments API.
blastRadius: Optional authentication for comment author following state
Comment list query consistency and serialization
contracts: One API endpoint per PR; base is Phase 5B PR #61.
No N+1 author-follow queries; anonymous responses mark authors as not followed.
Concurrent reads use a consistent database snapshot.
